title.en: An Act Converting the Existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in the Municipality of Dolores, Province of Eastern Samar, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in the Municipality of Dolores, Province of Eastern Samar, Into a Regular District Office and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Existing Land Transportation Office thành Văn phòng Khu vực Chính quy tại Đô thị Dolores, Tỉnh Eastern Samar, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Existing Land Transportation Office เป็น สำนักงานเขตปกติ ในเทศบาล Dolores จังหวัด Eastern Samar และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Kantor Perluasan Existing Land Transportation Office menjadi Kantor Distrik Reguler di Kotamadya Dolores, Provinsi Eastern Samar, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu

text.en: Upgrading of the Existing LTO Extension Office in Dolores, Eastern Samar. - The existing Land Transportation Office (LTO) Extension Office in the Municipality of Dolores, Province of Eastern Samar, is hereby converted into a regular district office.

Funding. - The Secretary of the Department of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the regular LTO Extension Office in the Municipality of Dolores, Province of Eastern Samar, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
